title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
name_bilingual: 斩斧能量槽最大 / Switch Axe Energy Max
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Dynamic 28 - Switch Axe Energy Max

preimages.meaning: 中文：正增量分支把当前能量与本次整数增量相加；替换为 100 后继续执行原生 extsh/sth/上界钳制。 / English: Positive-delta branch adds the integer delta to current energy; replacement 100 still flows through native extsh/sth/upper-bound clamping.
中文：零/负增量分支执行同一加法；剑模式 r4=-4 的实机消耗断点命中该事务。 / English: Zero/negative-delta branch performs the same addition; the live sword-drain trace hit this transaction with r4=-4.

anchors.meaning: 中文：原生斩斧能量 delta writer 入口；实机分别捕获 r4=-4 消耗与 r4=+5 回充。 / English: Native Switch Axe gauge-delta writer entry; live traces captured r4=-4 drain and r4=+5 recharge.
中文：正增量结果按 16 位有符号数规格化并设置条件码，保持不变。 / English: Native signed-16 normalization and condition-code update for the positive result, left intact.
中文：正增量结果写入运行时对象 +0x62C 的 16 位字段，保持不变。 / English: Native positive-result halfword store to runtime object +0x62C, left intact.
中文：零/负增量结果按 16 位有符号数规格化并设置条件码，保持不变。 / English: Native signed-16 normalization and condition-code update for the zero/negative result, left intact.
中文：零/负增量结果写入运行时对象 +0x62C 的 16 位字段，保持不变。 / English: Native zero/negative-result halfword store to runtime object +0x62C, left intact.
中文：原生上界仍比较 100，保持不变。 / English: Native upper bound remains 100 and is left intact.

known_risks: 中文：补丁依赖斩斧原生能量更新事务；刚进入任务、换装或对象重建后，第一次事务发生前 HUD 可能短暂保留初始化值。 / English: The patch intentionally relies on the native Switch Axe gauge transaction; after quest entry, equipment change, or object reconstruction, the HUD may briefly retain its initialized value until the first transaction.
中文：不得与其他修改 0x0285DEFC、0x0285DF48 或斩斧能量 writer 的 Pack 同时启用。 / English: Do not combine with another pack modifying 0x0285DEFC, 0x0285DF48, or the Switch Axe gauge writer.

runtime_evidence.cemu_build: Nemessix Cemu 2.6 RelWithDebInfo / GDBStub Persistent build 1dcbefc
runtime_evidence.field_contract: r3 outer player +0x0E30 -> weapon runtime object; signed 16-bit gauge at +0x062C, whose big-endian low byte is +0x062D
runtime_evidence.negative_control: The previous +0x64 3DS offset and +0x6C Wii U layout hypothesis remained zero and were rejected on this object.

verification.runtime_mapping: PASS: one same-lifecycle strict field; identical outer/inner object chain; native negative drain and positive recharge execution paths both hit
verification.static: PASS: exact JP-v96 preimages 2/2; replacement words 0x39400064 at both sites; real Cemu PPCAssembler 2/2 with zero relocations
verification.gameplay: PASS: on 2026-08-25 the local user cold-started the isolated exact-JP-v96 Cemu environment, tested the Switch Axe in quest, and explicitly accepted the maximum-energy behavior.

license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：斩斧能量发生原生回充或消耗事务时，将实际写回值固定为 100，使剑模式攻击不再降低能量，并在任务内首次能量更新后保持满槽。状态：Runtime Verified / Gameplay Passed；字段、正/负 writer 与两处补丁均由同生命周期快照、PPC 执行断点和 2026-08-25 本机隔离冷启动玩法验收闭环；默认关闭。 / English: Whenever the native Switch Axe gauge recharge/drain transaction runs, force its writeback to 100 so sword attacks no longer reduce energy and the gauge stays full after the first in-quest energy update. Status: Runtime Verified / Gameplay Passed. The field, positive/negative writer paths, and both patch sites are closed by same-lifecycle snapshots, PPC execution breakpoints, and local isolated cold-start gameplay acceptance on 2026-08-25; disabled by default.

gameplay_evidence.scope_zh: 隔离 Cemu 冷启动、只启用本包后，用户在任务内验证“斩斧能量槽最大”效果并明确回执验收通过。
gameplay_evidence.scope_en: After a cold start of the isolated Cemu configuration with only this pack enabled, the local user verified the in-quest Switch Axe maximum-energy effect and explicitly accepted it.
gameplay_evidence.evidence_limit_zh: 用户回执确认核心玩法效果；未把未单独回报的猫车、任务失败或所有非斩斧武器穷举场景写成已验证。
gameplay_evidence.evidence_limit_en: The receipt confirms the core gameplay effect; carting, quest-failure, and exhaustive non-Switch-Axe scenarios were not separately reported and are not claimed as verified.
